mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspaces (owner_id, name, initials, color, icon) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{name}, #{initials}, #{color}, #{icon})
INSERT INTO workspace_invites (workspace_id, inviter_id, email, status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{inviterId}, #{email}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_invites SET status = #{status}, responded_at = NOW() WHERE invite_id = #{inviteId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_members (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{role})
